gaps.explanation: Re-read p6 (Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds, columns Water / Sewer / Total): 'Operating transfers in (out)' prints '-' in Water, '-' in Sewer and 5,000 only in the Total column; 'Net operating transfers' likewise Water '-', Sewer '-', Total 5,000. The fund columns themselves do not carry it (Water net income 45,690 + Sewer 162,788 = 208,478, Total 213,478: the report itself does not add up across columns by exactly this 5,000). The only other place the amount is printed is the all-funds budgetary comparison schedule p7 ('Transfers in' Actual 5,000, all funds of the primary government combined, together with Transfers out (34,209)), which names no fund. business_type.transfers_net 5,000 comes from the p6 Total column. No fund column prints the 5,000, so no fund line can be added (Total column never used; no derived figures). No detail change.
